subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: Should OpenClaw add a provider-neutral, persisted agent/session contract for exact provider-reported per-call costs, with OpenRouter as the first producer?
rationale: The remaining work chooses a durable runtime and persisted-state API boundary, cost provenance semantics, and fallback behavior; the merged accounting repair intentionally did not make that product decision.

options.title: Approve a provider-neutral exact-cost contract
options.body: Add an optional provider-reported cost structure with explicit source and units, preserve estimates separately, and expose per-turn and cumulative values through the chosen agent/session surface.

options.title: Keep exact costs provider-local
options.body: Retain current estimated-cost surfaces and direct users needing exact OpenRouter billing to provider tooling rather than persist a new cross-provider contract.

options.title: Stage through a narrow read-only surface
options.body: First add a non-persistent agent/session usage view that exposes available exact provider cost, then decide later whether transcript and session persistence are warranted.

recommendation.title: Approve a provider-neutral exact-cost contract
recommendation.body: Add an optional provider-reported cost structure with explicit source and units, preserve estimates separately, and expose per-turn and cumulative values through the chosen agent/session surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and prior review connect this person to the transport, session usage, agent metadata, and the existing product-direction discussion.
